initial_failure.count_basis: 5 epsilons times (2 widths times 3 layouts plus 3 widths times 2 views), plus the 65536-plane regression.

design.arithmetic: Separate contiguous SSE2 grouped variance and scalar strided paths. Preserve F32 narrowing before mean division and F64 variance division where the imported CPU does.
design.scratch: Six arithmetic words, plus exact output occupancy slots only for non-nested layouts. No per-row factor cache is needed because the CPU imposes no numeric scale refusal for NORM.
design.execution: Preflight output injectivity before writing. Compute each mean once, center output once while accumulating variance, and scale that centered output once.
design.legacy: No extra Prism request or heap allocation for older modes.
design.validation: Imported factory, independently imported CPU exact-word supplemental comparisons, metadata/alias/overlap refusals and grouped-rounding planted faults.
